headline: Cadence author applies metamorphic testing to a SystemVerilog RNM receiver model
fact: A Cadence DVCon U.S. 2026 paper applies metamorphic testing to a SystemVerilog real-number model of a receiver baseband, ADC, and automatic-gain-control system where a detailed test oracle is impractical. It defines relations for doubled or halved input, constant ADC magnitude, and plus-or-minus 6 dB RSSI changes and exercises them with randomized stimuli. This is a reported case study, not an AI method or a company-wide deployment claim.

sources.title: Application of Metamorphic Testing to Mixed-Signal Systems with Behavioral Models
sources.summary: The official proceedings record identifies Daniel Cross of Cadence and dates the presentation to March 3, 2026.

sources.title: Application of Metamorphic Testing to Mixed-Signal Systems with Behavioral Models — paper
